newsitem.title: KENYA: ATHLETICS-BOSTON WINNER AGUTA HURT IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-BOSTON WINNER AGUTA HURT IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: Reigning Boston marathon and Commonwealth 10,000 metres champion Lameck Aguta of Kenya was badly injured in a car crash on Saturday, Kenyan police said on Sunday.
Aguta sustained severe head injuries in the accident on the road between Molo and Kericho in Rift Valley Province.
A police spokesman said Aguta was initially taken to hospital in Nakuru but had fallen into a coma and had been flown to Nairobi for treatment on Sunday.
